title: EvalResult
description: The scored result of evaluating one agent run against one case.

artifact_id.description: The artifact (e.g. prompt, policy) used during the run.

scores.description: Dimension scores including at least an 'overall' key.

failure_category.description: Category of failure when status is 'fail'.

evidence.description: Evidence or explanation for the failure.

trajectory_summary.description: Summary of the agent's trajectory during the run.
